fields.label: Pricing Policy Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. Disabling skips ALL Pricing Wave hooks (zero-price block, new SKU gate, bulk-upload flagging, margin band check, LPG SLA timer).

fields.label: Flag-threshold (% change vs current rate)
fields.description: Any row whose new rate differs from the prevailing tier rate by more than this percent will be flagged and require explicit Head of Finance sign-off with mandatory justification text. Configurable so HO Sales can tune for market volatility (lower in calm periods, higher during NNPC depot price shocks).

fields.label: Block-threshold (% change vs current rate)
fields.description: Any row above this percent goes BEYOND Head of Finance — must be approved at CFO / MD level. Set to 0 to disable the second tier.

fields.label: Require Consultation Record on every bulk upload
fields.description: Forces uploader to capture Finance / PTL / Operations / Procurement sign-off rows before the upload can be submitted for approval.

fields.label: Block Item enablement until an approved tier row exists
fields.description: When checked, sungas.overrides.item_pricing_gate.require_tier_before_enable throws on Item.validate if `disabled` is being flipped from 1 -> 0 and no enabled `LPG Outlet Price Tier` row exists for the Item. Prevents new SKUs from going live without an approved price.

fields.label: Enable daily Margin Band Exception cron (P-9)
fields.description: Daily check that every active tier row's rate vs current WAC sits inside the band above. Out-of-band rows raise Margin Band Exception notifications. Disabled by default until the cron is shipped.

fields.label: LPG PCR SLA (minutes during trading hours)
fields.description: Pending LPG Price Change Requests stuck longer than this during trading hours auto-escalate.

fields.label: Expected captures per day for LPG market price
fields.description: Used by Pricing KPI reports to flag missing market-price snapshots.
